definition.en: The microtopic covers the material culture of steatite seals, terracotta figurines, and bronze/stone sculptures produced during the Indus Valley Civilisation.
definition.hi: The microtopic covers the material culture of steatite seals, terracotta figurines, and bronze/stone sculptures produced during the Indus Valley Civilisation.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is a recurring favorite for UPSC Prelims, especially regarding material iconography, artistic techniques like lost-wax casting, and specific artifacts found at sites like Mohenjo-daro and Harappa. Mains aspirants must understand these visual artifacts to interpret the socio-religious life, trade networks, and technological advancement of the Harappan people.
